对话 1.
Conversation 1.
我一直在考虑接下来搬出校园。学期。
I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.
唔。
Hmm.
我不知道这是否是个好主意。就像你妈妈和我都会担心的那样你一个人住在公寓里离家好远。
I don't know if that's a good idea, as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home.
此外，还有费用问题。
And then there's the expense, too.
我不确定我们是否负担得起。
I'm not sure we can afford it.
其实，我并不孤单。
Well, I wouldn't be alone, actually.
我宿舍里的三个朋友会跟我一起住吧。
Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me.
我们四个人，就不会花多少钱比住在宿舍里更舒服。
And with four of us, it wouldn't cost any more than living in the dorm.
你确定吗？
Are you sure about that?
大城市的租金很高，然后还有电费和燃气费。
Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas.
你把这些因素都考虑进去了吗？
Have you factored those in?
我们已经为这些费用以及网络费用做了预算。运输。
We've budgeted for those, and for internet and transportation.
而且，如果我们离……足够远市中心，租金足够低我们负担得起所有这些。
And, if we move far enough from the city centre, the rent is low enough for us to afford all of it.
听起来你会浪费好几个小时。每天都在路上，而不是学习。
It sounds like you'll be wasting several hours every day on the road instead of studying.
到校园大约需要一个小时，但是……我完全可以在公交车上学习。
It's about an hour to campus, but there's no reason I can't study on the bus.
毕竟，我高中时就做过这件事。那时候我的通勤时间更长。
After all, I did that during high school, and my commute was even longer then.
没错，但我不太明白你为什么这么说。想离开校园，经历这一切当成本相同时，就会出现这种问题。
That's true, but I'm not sure why you want to leave campus and go through all that trouble when the cost is the same.
原因有很多。
For a lot of reasons.
我们会有一个厨房，这样我们就可以做饭了。我们自己。
We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves.
我们每个人都会有自己的卧室，在那里我们可以学习，而不是去……图书馆。
And we'd each have our own bedroom, where we could study, instead of going to the library.
我们只会拥有更多的空间和隐私。
We'd just have more space and privacy.
我并不认为这样做的好处更大。缺点比优点多，但我会和对方讨论这个问题。你的母亲。
I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother.
对话 2.
Conversation 2.
早上好。
Good morning.
我想给我侄子买份礼物。劳伦斯。
I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence.
你好。
Hi.
你有什么想法吗？
Do you have anything in mind?
我不知道。
I'm not sure.
不。
No.
你知道10岁左右的男孩都喜欢什么吗？通常喜欢？
Do you know what boys aged around 10 typically like?
对于这个年龄段来说，我们最畅销的产品是今年我最喜欢的就是这个玩偶。
For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure.
它叫波波侠，非常受欢迎。
It's called Bobo Man, and it's incredibly popular.
它有什么作用吗？
Does it do anything?
单独来看，并非如此。
Not by itself.
它没有电池，如果你指的是这个的话。意思是。
It has no batteries, if that's what you mean.
有一部名为《波波侠》的动画片在年轻人中很受欢迎。你看，这是给孩子们玩的玩具。该剧的主角。
There's a Bobo Man cartoon popular amongst young children, you see, and this toy is the lead character from the show.
哦，我明白了。
Oh, I understand now.
我以前从未听说过，但我确实知道小劳伦斯喜欢卡通片。
I've never heard of it, but I do know little Lawrence loves cartoons.
你们还有其他受欢迎的玩具吗？
Do you have any other popular toys?
或许可以做一些教育性的东西？
Perhaps something educational?
是的当然。
Yes, of course.
这里就有几十个谜题。适合所有年龄段的儿童。
Right over here we have dozens of puzzles for children of all ages.
它们很有趣，很适合锻炼大脑。既可以单独玩，也可以和朋友一起玩。团体。
They are fun, great for exercising the mind, and can be played either alone or in groups.
我喜欢这种想法。
I like this sort of idea.
劳伦斯有个姐姐，比他稍大一些。所以也许可以玩个游戏在一起会很好。
Lawrence has a sister who is slightly older, so maybe a game that they can play together would be good.
这绝对是经典之作。
It's a total classic.
它从上世纪30年代就存在了。
It has been around since the 1930s.
哦，是的，我们以前也有一个那样的成长。
Oh yeah, we had one of those when growing up.
你当然会这么做。
Of course you did.
大家都这么做了，孩子们也很喜欢。今天的情况和你我当时的情况很相似。我们当时还年轻。
Everyone did, and kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young.
有些游戏永远不会过时。
Some games just never get old.
我想你是对的。
I suppose you are right.
我对玩战舰游戏有着美好的回忆。外面下着雨，我们不得不待在家里。室内。
I have fond memories playing Battleships when it was raining outside, and we had to stay indoors.
那就这么定了。
That's decided, then.
多少？
How much?
请付19.90英镑。
£19.90, please.
你在那里。
There you are.
祝你今天过得愉快。
Have a nice day.
谢谢。
Thank you.
你也是。
You too.
